gloss_en: "a sword for the LORD" (cherev la-Hashem) — the scriptural phrase of a sword devoted to God (cf. Isaiah 34:6, Jeremiah 47:6), used in Likutey Moharan I:37 as an aspect linked to breath without sin and to the charity of the Land of Israel; the noun חֶרֶב (sword) with the divine dative, not the adjective חָרֵב (dry/desolate)
